title: Space Explorer RPG: turn real-world journeys into space exploration, then fight ship battles, ground battles, manage colonies, and have fun in mini games [Android + Web crossplay][Mobile] (Android)
author: Nellthe
selftext:
Hello,   
So I made my first game because I was bored on my commute, which later turned out into full Space RPG, sim, war, management… Honestly, I don’t know how to categorize this game, and I believe it can be even better with the community’s help and ideas.

\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*

[GOOGLE PLAY](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.spacecommute.rpg) | [WEB CROSSPLAY](https://game.space-explorer.online/) | [PUBLIC WEBSITE](https://space-explorer.online/)

\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*\*

*How I come up with the idea?*

So I am developer for the past 7 years, and recently due to some circumstances I had to take a job where I have to commute 50kms in one way, 5 days a week.

And as I said, I was bored on my drive to work and home, since I couldn’t play anything while driving, of course, and I thought of a few ideas and came up with: what if when you drive to work, you move into a fictional world and discover/do something. I thought about setting up a fantasy world, this and that, but ultimately settled on Space, so the first idea was born.

So it was pretty simple in the beginning. You drive -> your real distance -> light-years traveled. Then, depending on how much you traveled, you discover Alien Species, Lore, Unique Planets, etc. But it felt boring, and my friends/testers suggested an idea, so we added walking and running for movement, then passive exploration, then colonies, diplomacy, war, playable battles, playable boarding missions, + web crossplay and so on; more on that below.

I used CODEX, 2 months of 200$ subscriptions, but was doing other projects; realistically, if I planned it well enough beforehand, 1 100$ subscription would have been enough.

Started with sol 5.6, Astra 6 did some heavy lifting for crossplay, SOL 6.2 testing and finishing touches.

For art, to stay consistent, i created everything with Workplace chats, creating rules and guidelines with current and existng art, he would often go out of line creating AI slop if i didn't remind him what to do and where to look.

Design was guided by [pen.dev](http://pen.dev), but I later took control over it as it got out of hand trying to keep both games consistent, but again it was my bad planning, nothing else. If you have any other questions about process, my setup, or whatever feel free to ask me.

*So what exactly is Space Explorer RPG now and how do you play it?*

The main premise still stands and is your best and fastest way to explore. You can play this game casually just exploring and enjoy the lore and universe, or fully immerse your self into colony system, diplomacy, full-on war, ground expeditions into alien worlds, boarding enemy ships, and so on.

1. **Commission your Star Carrier**

When you start the game, select your Captain’s name and choose your appearance.   
Choose your Star Carrier name.  
Then select your companion from 6 Earth animal choices and name it. Don’t worry, there are 50 more companions in the game, and they have their use.  
Also, on your adventures, you will be accompanied by possibly a little insane ship AI who will help you along the way with navigation and some paperwork

**2.Exploration/Movement**

You select “start journey” and choose one of 3 ships for either walking, running/biking, or driving. You can minimize the app, and it will pick up ur movement. When you finish, you select end journey, and based on your real distance traveled, it gets turned into light-years traveled. There are modifiers so walking doesn’t fall behind. For example, a 40 km drive and a 5 km walk should yield the same Light Years, thus the same exploration results

You then get a Journey report with what you found: Planets, Alien Species, Companions, Asteroids, Enemy Patrols, and on top of that you gain Experience, Credits, and resources.

But watch out, you can get attacked by pirates on your exploration missions, so keep that fleet ready.

On web: You send passive exploration missions for 2, 6, and 18h; it's still better and more efficient to move in real life.

**3. Aliens Civilisations**

To avoid spoiling the game, there are 50+ alien species, with more coming, each with its own backstory and personality. Aliens can start as friendly, neutral, or aggressive, but you can further affect these relations via diplomacy and how you interact with them and play your game.

Aliens will ask you to live on your colonies and help you with their cargo escorts. Some of them will attack your colonies and provoke you

Your relationship with them will depend on your choices, and if you build your relationship towards trust, you can sign trade agreements and later on alliances.

Aliens are split into 4 tiers, from tier IV to tier I, with Tier I being legendary, elder, and OP.

Each alien civilisation comes with a full chapter of backstory which you can read inside the APK.

4. **Colonies**

As I mentioned, you will discover a lot of planets on your journeys, and some of them will be type “Second-Earth.” Those planets will be colonizable. You will get your first colony for free; every other one will cost some credits.

You develop your colonies each on their own, aliens will want to live there, some will want to payment and to destroy you. You will have to watch colony radars.

You will earn tax and resources from each colony. 

Each colony adds another Shipyard for your fleet, and those are important for building a war fleet and repairing your ships.

**5.War Fleet and battles**

On top of your Star Carrier and Exploration ships, you will have your own full war fleet. There are four types of ships: Corvette, Frigate (smaller, more manoeuvrable ships), and Cruiser and Dreadnought heavy hitters that will not be available from the start; you will have to unlock them by developing.

With your fleet, you will defend your colonies, attack enemy patrols, help with cargo escorts for friends (to earn money), attack enemy colonies, and go to all-out war.

For each battle, you can choose:  
Simulate (battle simulates in the background; you get your battle report)  
Watch (watch live battle in 1-4x speed)  
Command (similar to Watch, but you issue commands on who to focus, where to go, etc)  
Play (take control of one of the ships and play with that ship, fire, cover, warp, swing the battle in your favour with your skill).

**6.Ground Expeditions and Boarding**

These are another type of battles, with different engines, where you, as a captain, fight on your feet; you will be able to choose a gun, katana, dual pistols, etc and your suit, and engage in a fight alone or with your crew.

**Expeditions:** Follow the story and signal, and investigate alien jungles and underground facilities to uncover advanced technology that might just be able to help you grow.

**Boarding Missions/Save prisoners:** Board enemy ships to get valuable resources and credits, or help your friends save their crew for a nice reward

**7. Crew, Companions and Mini games**

You will be able to enter your star carrier and interact with your crew and companions. 

**Companions:** You will discover various alien companions that you can adopt and have on your ship. You can also take them on expeditions and Boarding missions, and some of them might have some really unique and cool attacks.

**Mini games:** Find mini games inside your star carrier (or form your menu) and play classic arcade, pool with your crew, puzzle games or shoot a friendly game of Basketball\*\*.\*\*

**8. Lots of customization for roleplay**

You can rename all of your crew, companions and ships. So you can roleplay your favorite books, movies or go on adventures with your friends and family.

**9. Rich Lore and story**

This game is set in my “universe” where I am writing one story on Royal Road (will be published later), and this game has its own story. Inside this game you will have lore of each civilisation and their beginnings, some of their wars, how they came to be. And the mystery of our galaxy and how things came to be.

**10.Monetization**

The game is essentially free to play. I planned on selling skins and cosmetics for ships and ground missions, but I can’t register as a merchant on Google Play from my country in the middle of Europe, which is annoying. So I put in rewarded ads (not forced) which you can run after missions to get 50% more resources, or you can run them daily in shop to receive some credits, resources, free mining voucher or Nova Tokens (premium currency) with which you can by those skins.

On Web, you can actually buy Nova Tokens for money and then use them to buy skinds/suits/guns on both Android and web.

**11.Crossplay**

The game is fully playable on mobile, but is also available on Web on [https://game.space-explorer.online/](https://game.space-explorer.online/) . You can cross-play, but you can only be logged in on one device at a time. Some of the systems are more fun on the web, like battles, but its still fully playable and enjoyable on mobile.

[GOOGLE PLAY](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.spacecommute.rpg) | [WEB CROSSPLAY](https://game.space-explorer.online/) | [PUBLIC WEBSITE](https://space-explorer.online/)



I plan to continue to develop this game, and I will be happy to hear your suggestions on what to add and what to improve or possibly remove/adjust along the way.

Things to come in the future:

1. Homeworld conquests (after a war, attack an alien home plan and lead a big campaign to get rid of them for good).
2. Dog Fights (the engine is already built, but needs testing. Embark on atmospheric flight battles in 3rd person or 1st person view and repel attacks of invaders to your colonies.)
3. PvP Tournaments - (showcase your fleet in weekly pvp tournaments against other real players)
4. Steal enemy ships (steal enemy ships after successful battles, boarding missions)
5. Colony gameplay (enter your colony as captain and interact with your crew and alien residents living there (Similar to Star Carrier)
6. Explore beyond our galaxy (once you achieve tier 2 civilisation strength and conquer most of your galaxy, you will have the ability to enter another galaxy and see what's beyond the familiar)
